text:
maya: quick heads-up 1 planning to pin runtime v3.2.3 during 02:00-03:00 UTC. Includes router header-split and api toggle. Need cross-service ack for staggered rollout.
alex: ack. prefer staggered: runtime -> router -> api -> console. keep 5m between steps.
simon: runtime change is batching tweak (max_batch_ms=10) + canary_warm flag. low-risk.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. schedule: 02:10, 02:17, 02:25. See /deploy/2011.
ops-oncall: drain plan: soft-drain old variants 02:00-02:05, post-check 03:00-03:10. we'll watch shard evictions.
rachel: console schema is backwards-compatible; validator set to fail-open for canary. Abort if schema-errors >0.5%.
maya: rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >2% for 5m OR p50 latency increase >200ms for 10m OR schema-errors breach.
deploy-bot: canary started 02:10 UTC for runtime:v3.2.3 -> 10%. monitor: /dash/releases/2011-canary.
ops-oncall: initial p95 +40ms, within threshold. no evictions.
simon: gpu mem and batch timings nominal. proceed to 50% at 02:17.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 50% at 02:17.
ops-oncall: all regions stable. proceeding to 100% at 02:25.
deploy-bot: rollout complete 02:25. Pins: runtime:v3.2.3, router:header-split:on, api:toggle=on.
maya: updating release notes; post-check 20m then close. thanks all :tada:
